item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Hasina explicitly pursued nuclear disarmament, arms restraint, or another clearly stated existential-risk-reduction agenda. The positive evidence is therefore indirect: refugee containment, border vigilance, and climate adaptation. The direct 2024 record instead centers on domestic coercion during the protest crisis, which weighs against 1B.1.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the nationwide curfew in place after deadly student protests and blamed political opponents for the violence.
